_note: Hand-curated gold CL terms for hECA spleen labels. Assigned from each cluster's 50-gene marker set under the rule used for the other organs: the label is visible but is not evidence, and where the markers contradict it the markers decide. null is an explicit abstention, not a miss.
_curated: 2026-08-21; markers read per cluster, CL release 2026-06-08
_disagreements: Myeloid cell -> neutrophil: CXCR2, FCGR3B, MMP25, TREM1 and ALPL. FCGR3B is the gene the lung marker-condition proposal requires, which is what makes its absence there meaningful. Mesodermal killer cell -> megakaryocyte: GP9, GP1BA and CLEC1B are platelet glycoproteins. This cluster is also the one the proposal queue listed as a new-term request whose lexical near-match was 'mesodermal cell'; the markers settle it. Conventional dendritic cell (940 cells) -> plasmacytoid dendritic cell: CLEC4C is BDCA-2, with SPIB.
_abstentions: Mast cell: MS4A1 is CD20 and no tryptase or chymase appears, so the label is contradicted without anything else being supported. Double positive T cell: nothing shows CD4/CD8 co-expression. ILC: TNFRSF4 and TNFRSF18 are Treg/activated-T rather than ILC. CD4 Trm: RORA is suggestive but neither CD4 nor residency is supported.
_coarse: CD4 Tem is recorded as T cell and CD8 Tem as effector memory CD8: the markers support the lineage but not every qualifier the label claims.
_recuration: Re-curated 2026-08-21 from the markers alone, after the first pass was made with the pipeline's own candidate ranking visible in the sheet. That ranking is one of the two things the gold exists to score, so its presence made the measurement partly circular -- the same failure this study documents for the label. The sheets no longer carry it. Re-deriving every call from the marker genes changed no call in this organ.
